svg.text: One point per run; black bar = median. Filled circle = game over; triangle = time limit; hollow circle = outcome unavailable.
Stage 1 / three ships / 900-second budget. Local policy snapshots, not released versions. Different seed panels are not paired.
A3a Oct 20 | hazard policy, paired seeds
A3b Oct 20 | hazard policy, new seeds
A3c Oct 20 | retained hazard policy, matched baseline
A6c Oct 20 | integrated skill ladder, fresh
A3d Oct 20 | old policy control for A6c
Dashed marks: Expert 75k and Professional 150k targets. Censored scores are lower bounds, not final career scores.
